format: UCWDC Solo Medley and Showdance (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Solo Medley is a musically mixed, multi-dance Showcase category with a medley choreographed to music of the competitors' choice; Showdance is a single dance choreographed to music of the competitors' choice.

requirement: DanceFlow's Country Solo is its own format and is neither UCWDC Solo Medley nor Showdance. A future UCWDC profile must model both separately.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: UCWDC profile. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
